decisions.viewport: 960x640 is the game surface (the side-panel cabinet); the same game fills any iframe or fullscreen size
decisions.orientation: portrait: in an emulated phone the board is 374x768 px at 390x844 (syringe 30.2 px) against 812x358 px with a 260 px wide board between the side panels at 844x390 (syringe 19.6 px)
decisions.mobileFriendly: false until a physical phone passes the touch run; touch worked end to end in an emulated phone (tap to start, drag, SOAP, pause and resume, FORMULATE select and INJECT)
